pre_existing_failures_now_fixed.root_cause: A family of Gate/Contract/Coverage and visualizer.renderers tests read their own Kotlin source from disk using the OLD package path com/nasmusic/tv/, while the real package is com/lnh/nasmusictv/, causing FileNotFoundException / '找不到 UI 源码目录'. Fix: replaced the hardcoded package segment in 59 test files (143 occurrences).

Test-side fragility / gate drift only, production logic untouched: (1) NetworkMusicManagerTest cancellation tests asserted reference equality (===) on a CancellationException that withContext(Dispatchers.IO) legitimately recreates -> changed to type/propagation assertions; (2) VisualizerQualityWiringTest asserted a never-created bare key 'settings_visualizer_quality' -> changed to enumerate all settings_visualizer_quality* keys and require an English counterpart in values-en.
